clue.text: The woodcutter's puzzle

definitions.meaning: a woodcutter's tool, read as a saw for cutting curves in wood
a picture cut into interlocking pieces to be fitted together

explanation.definitionFit: A fretsaw for curved cuts and a picture-assembly game share the one name.

clue.text: His a lean hungry look?

parts.note: a nursery-rhyme man who could eat no fat, borrowing Cassius's lean and hungry look from Julius Caesar

explanation.definitionFit: The nursery-rhyme man ate no fat, so he would be lean and look hungry.

clue.text: Oral trouble of one student after soup

indicators.note: after means the one-and-student pieces come behind the soup

parts.note: gumbo is a thick Creole soup from Louisiana
the Roman numeral I is one
L is for learner, as on a British learner driver's plate

explanation.surface: Someone at the table gets a mouth problem after eating soup.
explanation.definitionFit: An abscess on the gum is a painful mouth complaint.

clue.text: First gardener couldn't quite swallow it apparently

definitions.text: First gardener couldn't quite swallow it apparently

parts.words: First gardener couldn't quite swallow it apparently
parts.note: the man of Eden, the first gardener, is said to have had the forbidden fruit lodge in his throat

explanation.definitionFit: The throat lump is folk-explained as forbidden fruit stuck in Eden's first man's throat.

clue.text: What hinders old boy backing the Spanish musical?

parts.note: OB is the standard abbreviation for old boy, a former pupil

indicators.note: backing means the two following words, taken together, are read from the end towards the start

parts.note: el is the Spanish for 'the'
Cats is the long-running Lloyd Webber musical

explanation.surface: Someone asks what obstructs a former pupil who is funding a Spanish stage show.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backing' turns the Spanish article and the show together, so the whole pair is read from its end; 'musical' looks like an adjective but is a noun here.
explanation.definitionFit: A hindrance or barrier is anything that gets in the way of progress.

clue.text: Broadway in Paris?

parts.note: a broad avenue, as the French name a wide tree-lined street

explanation.definitionFit: A wide city street in French is a broad way, not the New York theatre district.

clue.text: Hit a bull dead centre, but not allowed

indicators.note: dead centre tells you to take letters from the very middle of the words Hit a bull

explanation.surface: A darts player hits the bullseye squarely, but the throw is disallowed.
explanation.definitionFit: A variant spelling of taboo, meaning forbidden.

clue.text: Oaks described as of ancient Rome

definitions.meaning: the Oaks is one of the five English flat-racing ..., run at Epsom
belonging to Greek or Roman antiquity

explanation.definitionFit: The Epsom race is one of the five Classics, and Roman antiquity is classical.

clue.text: Poetic form for instance in a cathedral city

indicators.note: in places the abbreviation for instance inside the city

parts.note: Ely is a small English cathedral city in Cambridgeshire
eg is the abbreviation of exempli gratia, for instance

explanation.surface: An example of a poem found inside a city with a cathedral.
explanation.walkthrough: Gray's famous poem of this kind was written in a country churchyard, fitting the cathedral setting.
explanation.definitionFit: A mournful poem of lament is a recognised verse type.

clue.text: "Fairy" to many would spell danger

indicators.note: would spell means the fairy plus fifty make up the word for danger, so fifty comes off it

parts.note: peril is danger
L is the Roman numeral fifty, a large number

explanation.surface: To many people, a fairy is a sign of approaching danger.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue reads backwards: fairy added to L ('many') spells PERIL, so removing L from PERIL leaves the fairy.
explanation.definitionFit: In Persian myth, a peri is a beautiful spirit or sprite.

clue.text: The fellow's a communist

definitions.meaning: a companion or mate, someone alongside you
the form of address used among party members

explanation.definitionFit: The word means a companion, and it was the title communists gave each other.

clue.text: No light offence?

definitions.meaning: shade or shadow, an old sense from Latin umbra

explanation.definitionFit: Its archaic sense is shade or shadow; its modern sense is resentment, as when one takes it.

clue.text: Such goods might be sold, one hopes, at reduced prices

definitions.text: Such goods might be sold, one hopes, at reduced prices

indicators.note: might be suggests the letters could become something else when rearranged

parts.note: the Roman numeral I stands for one

explanation.surface: A shopkeeper hopes damaged stock will still find buyers if marked down.
explanation.walkthrough: The anagram signal 'might be' rearranges SOLD, I and HOPES; the whole clue also describes such stock.
explanation.definitionFit: Stock that is slightly damaged or faded from display in a store is typically marked down for a quick sale.

clue.text: Like Lady Jane having a fling?

parts.note: a shy is a throw, as at a coconut shy

explanation.surface: A Tudor noblewoman seems to be having an affair.
explanation.walkthrough: Lady Jane Grey was the nine-day queen of England; grey is ash-coloured. 'Fling' suggests romance but means a throw.
explanation.definitionFit: Lady Jane's surname was Grey, and grey is the colour of ash.

clue.text: In favour of giving up, say, the Lord Mayor's Show

parts.note: pro means for, in favour of
a cession is the giving up of territory or rights

explanation.surface: Supporting someone's resignation, maybe, at the City of London's annual parade.
explanation.walkthrough: The Lord Mayor's Show is the annual parade through the City of London; 'say' marks it as an example.
explanation.definitionFit: The London event is a grand parade of floats and marchers.

clue.text: It's right to pass and fall back

parts.note: time passing is said to elapse

explanation.surface: A sports move: move right to pass, then retreat.
explanation.definitionFit: A patient who worsens again after improving has slipped back.

clue.text: Maybe treat nine to dinner

indicators.note: Maybe hints that the letters given could be arranged another way

explanation.surface: A host considers inviting nine guests for a meal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Maybe' rearranges TREAT and NINE; the whole clue is also an example of hosting.
explanation.definitionFit: Having guests round for a meal is a way of hosting them.

clue.text: Paddy almost invested in a pot of this jam

indicators.note: invested in means one piece is placed inside the words a pot

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: almost means the last letter of the word for a paddy is dropped

parts.note: a paddy is a field where rice is grown, so the crop stands for it

explanation.surface: An Irishman nearly put money into a jar of preserves.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Paddy' looks like an Irishman's name; here it points to the crop. RIC sits inside A POT.
explanation.definitionFit: The orange fruit is a common flavour of preserve, so 'this jam' names the fruit.

clue.text: Study musical overture in Eulenspiegel — laborious work

indicators.note: in places the study-plus-overture pieces inside the name

parts.note: Till Eulenspiegel is the German folk prankster of Strauss's tone poem
to read a subject is to study it at university

indicators.note: overture means the opening letter of the word musical

explanation.surface: Analysing the opening of a Strauss tone poem is hard going.
explanation.walkthrough: Strauss wrote a tone poem about the prankster, so 'musical' seems to describe him; 'overture' takes only the first letter of 'musical'.
explanation.definitionFit: Tedious, repetitive toil is likened to a mill turned by walking.

clue.text: Musician's ABC perhaps …

parts.note: a group of three letters in a row, like three notes played as a group

explanation.definitionFit: A group of three notes in music is named the same as any group of three, such as A, B and C.

clue.text: Force of attack makes me sit up

indicators.note: makes signals the words me sit up are formed into something new

explanation.surface: A forceful assault jolts someone to attention.
explanation.definitionFit: Momentum or driving force is what gives an assault its power.

clue.text: … two followers end with "Death of a Lawyer"

parts.note: the two letters that follow ABC from the previous clue are D and E
to end is to cease

explanation.surface: Continuing a mystery-novel title sequence: a lawyer's death closes the series.
explanation.walkthrough: The ellipsis links to 19 across, so the followers are those of ABC.
explanation.definitionFit: In legal language, a person's death is formally termed their demise or passing.

clue.text: Flower sign raised in one Scottish environment

indicators.note: in, with environment, means the sign sits enclosed within the Scots word
environment means the Scots word surrounds the other piece

parts.note: ane is the Scots form of one

indicators.note: raised in a down clue means the word is read upwards, from bottom to top

parts.note: an omen is a sign

explanation.surface: A bloom grown in one corner of Scotland.
explanation.walkthrough: 'raised' reverses the sign upwards in this down clue, and 'in ... environment' puts it inside the Scots word for one.
explanation.definitionFit: A windflower with bright cup-shaped blooms is a garden plant.

clue.text: Record first attained, by winner of race

definitions.meaning: a recording medium, magnetic or otherwise

definitions.text: first attained, by winner of race
definitions.meaning: the strip stretched across the finish line that the winner breaks first

explanation.definitionFit: It is both a magnetic recording strip and the finishing line strip a race winner breaks.

clue.text: Fearful upset of light reduction order

indicators.note: upset in a down clue means the phrase is turned upside down, read upwards

parts.note: a command to lower the light: dim it

explanation.surface: Someone frightened by an instruction to lower the lights.
explanation.definitionFit: A nervous, easily frightened person is shy and lacking courage.

clue.text: A veil drawn over this stately home

definitions.meaning: a wedding veil covers the head of the woman being married
the grand house of Waugh's novel of that name, Revisited

explanation.definitionFit: A bride's head is covered by a veil, and Waugh named his fictional country house so.

clue.text: Wordsworth's "Stern daughter of the voice of God"

definitions.text: Wordsworth's "Stern daughter of the voice of God"

parts.words: Wordsworth's "Stern daughter of the voice of God"
parts.note: the opening line of Wordsworth's ode addressed to moral obligation

explanation.definitionFit: Wordsworth's 1805 ode opens by addressing moral obligation with that phrase.

clue.text: Muse about rise of fuel

parts.note: c is circa, Latin for about

indicators.note: rise of in a down clue means the word is read upwards

parts.note: oil is a fuel

explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'rise of' means the fuel is read from the bottom up, after the circa abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: The Muse of history in Greek myth is one of the nine.

clue.text: Australian's swag was unbelievable

definitions.meaning: in Australian slang, a swagman's bundle, as in the song Waltzing
Belloc's cautionary-tale girl who told such dreadful lies nobody believed her

explanation.definitionFit: Australians name a bushman's bedroll so, and Belloc's lying girl bore the same name.

clue.text: Voyage to a sort of oil port

parts.note: a trip is a voyage or journey

indicators.note: a sort of signals the letters of the following word are rearranged into another form

explanation.surface: A sea journey made to collect some type of fuel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a sort of' rearranges OIL to OLI.
explanation.definitionFit: The Libyan capital is a Mediterranean harbour city.

clue.text: Don't believe all that the shopkeeper offers

definitions.meaning: to disregard or doubt a story
a price reduction given to customers

explanation.definitionFit: To dismiss a claim is to discount it, and a shop's price cut is one too.

clue.text: A foreign water supply that is not healthy

parts.note: un is the French for 'a'
a well is a source of water

explanation.surface: An overseas water source is unsafe to drink from.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who is ill or poorly is not in good health.
